answer: Cohort-scaled identity rent makes each new agent prepay a per-period fee set by the current signup tide, rising convexly with same-window registrations rather than blocking them. Validated work mints jade credits that offset that fee only after a delay, so fresh identities cannot self-fund. An attacker’s tenth identity in a day pays, say, 512 units plus a 30-day lock, and any early-credit ripple is clawed back if work fails review.
